candidates.title: Qdrant Edge demonstrates local-first visual memory for smart glasses
candidates.summary: The public qdrant-edge-demo implements a smart-glasses proof of concept in which glasses create CLIP embeddings locally, retain searchable local memory, queue data offline, offload expensive HNSW indexing, and sync compact indexed snapshots back to the device.

candidates.title: Smart-glasses privacy restrictions broaden beyond Norway
candidates.summary: New reporting indicates smart-glasses restrictions and reviews are emerging beyond Norway, including government-workplace and court contexts. Preserve as an emerging policy pattern; individual jurisdictional claims require their cited documentary or reporting sources.

candidates.title: Ray-Ban Meta firmware rollout adds navigation and audio accessibility controls
candidates.summary: Specialist reporting says Ray-Ban Meta v128 walking navigation is reaching broader availability and v129 is beginning rollout with Mono Audio and Audio Balance accessibility controls. Treat rollout status as reported until independently reproduced.
